groups.name: Uses CSS grid with flexbox
groups.definition: Does the page layout rely on CSS grid and/or flexbox (rather than tables) for its structure?

groups.name: Narrow centered content container
groups.definition: Is the main content held in a centered, fixed or max-width container with generous side margins?

groups.name: Single column of stacked full-width sections
groups.definition: Is the page a single column of stacked full-width bands with no sidebar?

groups.name: Alternating zig-zag image/text rows
groups.definition: Do feature or split sections alternate image and text sides in a zig-zag?

groups.name: Two-column split hero
groups.definition: Is the hero split into two columns with text on one side and an image or form on the other?

groups.name: Two-column text/content sections
groups.definition: Do intro, about or content sections use a two-column layout (heading/text beside text/photo/lists)?

groups.name: Multi-column card grids
groups.definition: Are list or feature items shown as multi-column grids of uniform cards or tiles?

groups.name: Compact header with logo and inline nav
groups.definition: Is the header a compact single row with a small logo and navigation beside it?

groups.name: Multi-tier header
groups.definition: Does the header have several tiers such as announcement bar, utility bar and main nav?

groups.name: Dark multi-column footer
groups.definition: Is the footer a dark band with multiple columns of links, headings and a bottom legal/copyright bar?

groups.name: Compact footer
groups.definition: Is the footer compact, with inline links and a small logo above the copyright?

groups.name: Centered intro text in narrow measure
groups.definition: Are section headings and intro paragraphs centered in a narrow text column?

groups.name: Short compact page
groups.definition: Is the page short and compact with few sections and tight spacing?

groups.name: Tall airy page with generous spacing
groups.definition: Is the page tall with generous whitespace between sections?

groups.name: Text separate from images, no overlap
groups.definition: Are text and images in separate regions with no overlays, truncation or overlap?

groups.name: Hero text directly on image
groups.definition: Is the hero a left-aligned headline over a full-bleed photo or static background with no backing panel or carousel?

groups.name: Sidebar magazine layout
groups.definition: Does the page use a main column with a right sidebar?

groups.name: Full-width brand band
groups.definition: Is there a dedicated full-width dark band with large heading for a brand statement?

groups.name: Quick links horizontal row
groups.definition: Are quick links presented as a single horizontal row with a small label?

groups.name: Hero slides in fixed frame
groups.definition: Are hero images scaled and slides stacked in one centered fixed-width frame?

groups.name: Uneven card heights and orphans
groups.definition: Do card grids show uneven heights or orphaned cells?

groups.name: Long full-width paragraph lines
groups.definition: Do paragraphs span the full card width with long line lengths?

groups.name: Text-heavy content sits in a narrow centred white card with
groups.definition: Text-heavy content sits in a narrow centred white card with left-aligned lines.
